version_scheme: YYYY.MM.DD product release. Do not use PathTogether package.json 0.1.0 (test package) as the product version.

zh: 标注面板新增导出：右上角「导出全部」把当前切片上你能看到的全部标注下载为一个 GeoJSON 文件，每条标注下方的「导出」只下载这一条；在 QuPath 中用「File ▸ Import objects from file」或直接拖入导入。
AI 描绘和落标的结果会一起导出，并标明来源、审核状态、所用技能与模型以及是否经过轮廓精修，方便筛选后做数据分析。
导出坐标是切片原始分辨率（level-0）的像素坐标，与 QuPath、OpenSlide 打开同一文件时一致；文件中还记录了切片尺寸和像素尺寸（mpp，如有）。
标注面板整理：「加入 AI 对话」等按钮不再互相遮挡，长坐标和长文件名不再溢出；每条标注单独成卡片，名称更醒目。
10 月 19 日以前在工作台画的人工标注，不再被误显示成待审核的 AI 标注：不再出现「接受/驳回」按钮和 AI 橙色。
en: Annotation export in the annotation panel: “Export all” at the top downloads every annotation you can see on the current slide as one GeoJSON file, and “Export” under each annotation downloads just that one; QuPath imports them via File ▸ Import objects from file… or drag and drop.
AI delineations and placed markers are exported too, labelled with their source, review status, skill, model and whether the contour was refined, so you can filter them for analysis.
Coordinates are level-0 (full-resolution) pixels, matching QuPath and OpenSlide on the same file; the file also records the slide size and pixel size (mpp, when available).
Annotation panel cleanup: buttons such as “Add to AI chat” no longer overlap, long coordinates and file names no longer overflow, and each annotation now sits on its own card with a clearer name.
Annotations you drew in the workbench before October 19 no longer appear as AI annotations awaiting review: no more “Accept/Reject” buttons or AI orange.

zh: 切片转换器页面改版：把切片文件或文件夹拖到页面中间即可开始，也可以用「选择文件」「选择文件夹」按钮；页面列出主要特点、完整的支持格式和任务记录。
MRXS 切片可以先选 .mrxs 主文件，再按提示选择同名数据文件夹，不用从头重新选择；转换器和工作台上传都支持这样选。
转换完成后可以「保存到我的项目」：登录后选择保存位置，结果交给工作台上传并放进所选文件夹；未登录时会先引导登录或注册，注册后会提醒继续保存。
Mac 上保存大型 TIFF 后，系统缩略图进程可能造成数分钟卡顿；转换器在保存按钮旁增加了说明和可以尝试的缓解办法。
修复转换器的若干问题：连续转换两个多文件切片时可能读错文件；转换进程意外退出后任务不再卡住，可恢复的失败任务可以继续；浏览器清理了结果文件时给出明确提示；同一标签页一次只运行一个转换。
新增「支持项目」页面（转换器页面底部有入口）：可以给作者发邮件，也可以陪页面上的小猫玩一会儿。
en: The slide converter page is redesigned: drop slide files or a folder in the middle of the page to start, or use the “Choose file” / “Choose folder” buttons; the page lists the key features, the full set of supported formats and your job records.
For MRXS slides you can pick the .mrxs file first and then the same-named data folder when prompted, without starting over — in both the converter and workbench uploads.

After converting, “Save to my project” lets you pick a folder once signed in; the result is handed to the workbench upload and filed there. If you are not signed in you are guided to sign in or register, and reminded to finish saving afterwards.
On a Mac, saving a large TIFF may let the system thumbnail process slow things down for several minutes; the converter now explains this next to the save buttons, with a workaround to try.

Converter fixes: converting two multi-file slides in a row could read the wrong files; a crashed conversion no longer leaves the job stuck, and recoverable failed jobs can be resumed; a clear message when the browser has cleared the output file; one conversion at a time per tab.
New “Support the project” page (linked at the bottom of the converter): email the author, or play with the cat on the page for a while.

zh: 工作台上传一次完成：选择文件后自动准备（需要时在本机转换格式）、校验、上传并等待服务器处理，进度依次显示为「正在准备上传文件（格式转换中）」「正在上传（xx%）」「服务器正在处理」「上传成功」，切片可以打开后才显示成功。
上传进度、取消和重试直接显示在「导入切片」面板里，不必再展开侧栏查看。
上传中断后可「继续上传」同一任务，已确认的部分不会重传；状态检查失败可「重新检查状态」；等待另一个标签页时取消上传，不再卡住后面的文件。
切片转换器只在本机转换和保存，不再提供上传；需要上传时直接在工作台选择原文件，工作台会自动完成转换。
修复重试加载与保存标记同时进行时，标注列表可能退回旧内容或误显示加载失败的问题。
修复无法在 AI 对话中继续历史「深读」分支的问题；反馈问题、格式支持申请等说明更简洁。
en: Uploading from the workbench now runs end to end: after you pick files it prepares them (converting the format locally when needed), validates, uploads and waits for server processing, showing “Preparing upload (converting)”, “Uploading (xx%)”, “Server processing” and “Upload successful” — success only appears once the slide can be opened.
Upload progress, cancel and retry now appear right in the “Import slides” panel; no need to open the sidebar.

An interrupted upload can be continued on the same task without resending confirmed parts; a failed status check can be re-checked; cancelling while waiting for another tab no longer blocks the next files.
The slide converter now only converts and saves on your computer and no longer uploads; to upload, pick the original file in the workbench and it converts automatically.
Fixed the annotation list sometimes reverting to older content or showing a load error when a retry and a marker save overlapped.
Fixed continuing a past “deep read” branch in the AI chat; the feedback and format-support request notes are shorter.

zh: 选中标记后，浮条直接显示「✨ 加入 AI 对话」：标记会作为附件卡（显示标记名）加入当前对话，不会自动发送，已输入的文字保留；可一次加入多个标记，也可随时移除；还没保存的候选框也能直接加入。锁定位置移到「⋯」菜单。
AI 会同时看到你加入的标记（含名称与对应区域）和当前视野，并可结合其他区域判断；标注行内的「快速问答」「从此处深读」并入「加入 AI 对话」，历史批注对话仍可查看，并可在 AI 对话中继续。
修复拖动或缩放候选框时松开鼠标后框仍跟着鼠标移动、点不到「保存为标记」的问题；拖动被打断时框会回到原位，不会误保存。
修复新增一个标记后同一切片上较早的标记从列表中消失的问题；标注面板在标记更新或删除后立即刷新；列表加载失败时显示原因和「重试」，不再显示为「暂无标注」。
在工作台手绘的标记不再被当作「AI 待复核」，不再出现「接受」按钮；已完成或失败的上传行不再显示「取消」按钮；刷新页面后切片侧栏回到上次浏览的那一页。
上传归属更严格：读取本机上传记录失败时暂停并可重试，不会改用当前登录账号继续上传。
en: Selecting a marker now shows “✨ Add to AI chat” on the floating bar: the marker joins the current conversation as an attachment card (showing the marker’s name) without sending anything, and your typed text is kept. You can add several markers and remove them any time, and an unsaved candidate box can be added directly too. Lock position moved into the “⋯” menu.

The AI sees the markers you added — with their names matched to their regions — alongside your current view, and may look at other areas too. The per-annotation “Quick ask” and “Read deeper from here” entries are merged into “Add to AI chat”; past annotation chats stay readable and can be continued in the AI chat.
Fixed the candidate box sometimes following the mouse after release while moving or resizing it, which made “Save as marker” hard to click; an interrupted drag now puts the box back without saving.

Fixed older markers on a slide disappearing from the list after a new marker was added; the annotation panel also refreshes right after a marker is updated or deleted, and a failed list load now shows the reason and “Retry” instead of “No annotations”.

Markers you draw on the workbench are no longer treated as “AI, pending review” and no longer show “Accept”; finished or failed upload rows no longer show “Cancel”; and the slide sidebar returns to the page you were on after a reload.
Stricter upload ownership: if the local upload record can’t be read, the upload pauses with a retry instead of continuing under the currently signed-in account.

zh: 工作台上传先在浏览器识别文件格式：需要转换的切片直接在上传面板里排队转换并校验，通过后才上传，不再跳转到转换工具；扩展名与内容不符或暂不支持的格式会当场说明，并可一键申请支持该格式。
上传更稳：关闭页面或长时间无响应的上传会自动释放名额，失败时显示具体原因；换账号后不会把上一个账号的文件传到当前账号。
在已有 AI 对话里继续提问时，新问题和回答按顺序接在末尾，不再把之前的读片过程重新显示一遍。
修复连续删除或审核标记时可能作用到另一条标记的问题，现在每次操作都只针对你点的那一条。
转换工具兼容边缘瓦片略超出图像范围的 KFB 文件（此前会报「瓦片索引无效」）。
切片侧栏在展开或收起时不再偶尔变成「每页只显示一张」。
en: Workbench uploads now check the file format in your browser first: slides that need conversion are converted and validated right in the upload panel before uploading, with no detour to the converter. Mismatched or unsupported files are explained on the spot, with a one-click request to support the format.

More reliable uploads: uploads from closed or unresponsive pages release their slot automatically, failures show the specific reason, and switching accounts never sends the previous account’s files to the current one.
Follow-up questions in an existing AI conversation now appear in order at the end, without replaying the earlier reading steps.
Fixed deleting or reviewing markers in quick succession sometimes acting on a different marker; each action now applies only to the one you clicked.
The converter now accepts KFB files whose edge tiles slightly overrun the image (previously “invalid tile index”).
The slide sidebar no longer occasionally shows one slide per page after expanding or collapsing.

zh: 标记的「⋯」菜单新增「让 AI 解读」：一键把该标记加入 AI 对话并预填问题，确认后再发送；对话框里原来的「+」已移除。
修复带标记或视野附件向 AI 提问时出现的「HTTP 500」错误；删除或取消选中标记后浮动工具条不再残留，「⋯」菜单再点一次即可收起。
切片格式转换工具支持 JPEG 2000 编码的 Aperio SVS，转换在浏览器内完成。
工作台上传默认进入当前文件夹；刷新页面会回到原来的文件夹和页码，上传中途刷新也不会丢失文件夹归属。
首页顶栏精简，语言切换移到顶栏；注册只保留一项可选的「共享数据以帮助开发者改进本系统」。
主域名统一为 histopilot.cn，histopilot.com 为国际访问线路。
en: Added “Ask AI about this” to the marker ⋯ menu: it attaches the marker to the AI conversation with a suggested question, sent only when you confirm. The old “+” button in the chat box was removed.
Fixed an “HTTP 500” error when asking the AI with a marker or view attached; the marker toolbar no longer lingers after a marker is deleted or deselected, and clicking ⋯ again closes its menu.
The slide converter now supports JPEG 2000–compressed Aperio SVS, converted entirely in your browser.
Workbench uploads go to the current folder by default; refreshing returns to the same folder and page, and refreshing mid-upload keeps the folder assignment.
Simplified homepage top bar with the language switch moved there; sign-up now has a single optional data-sharing choice.
histopilot.cn is now the primary domain, with histopilot.com as the international route.

zh: 切片格式转换工具上线：首页首屏可直接进入，拖入文件即可识别并转换，无需登录。
支持 KFB、KFBF、JPEG 编码的 Aperio SVS，以及完整 MRXS 文件夹；可输出 OME-TIFF 或经典金字塔 TIFF，荧光输出多通道 OME-TIFF。
明场默认保留画质，新增“更小文件（有损）”选项；有损结果不适合颜色定量。
转换在本机浏览器完成，可保存到本机，也可登录后一键转换并上传到工作台；支持刷新后续跑。
上传显示字节进度，并区分排队、云端上传、工作台接收及发布状态。
en: The slide format converter is now featured on the homepage. Drop in a file to identify and convert it without signing in.
Supports KFB, KFBF, JPEG-compressed Aperio SVS and complete MRXS folders. Export OME-TIFF or classic pyramidal TIFF; fluorescence uses multichannel OME-TIFF.
Brightfield preserves quality by default, with an optional smaller-file lossy mode. Lossy output is not suitable for color quantification.
Conversion runs in your browser. Save locally, or sign in to convert and upload to the workbench in one step. Jobs can resume after a refresh.
Uploads now show byte progress with separate queued, cloud upload, workbench receiving and publishing stages.

zh: 修复英文示例切片名称与长名称显示。
Demo AI 导航单次上限提升至 100 步。
加强个人标注与分享链接的数据隔离，修正作者人数统计。
优化矩形与箭头绘制，支持撤销操作。
支持右键添加视野和标注到会话。
从标注开始分析时自动附带全片概览。
en: Fixed English sample slide names and long-name display.
Increased the demo AI navigation limit to 100 steps per run.
Improved annotation and share isolation and corrected author counts.
Improved rectangle and arrow drawing and added undo support.
Added context-menu actions to attach a view or annotation to a conversation.
Added a whole-slide overview when starting an analysis from an annotation.

zh: 改进 AI 观察、停止/继续与当前视野上下文。
首页登录弹窗与演示在手机和语言切换下更稳定。
支持测试申请、审核与激活通知。
修复百度网盘导入相关问题。
en: Improved AI observations, stop/resume pairing, and current-view context.
Stabilized the homepage login dialog and demo on mobile and language switch.
Added test-application submission, review, and activation notices.
Fixed Baidu Netdisk import issues.
